name: @mixdog/desktop
description: Mixdog desktop host for Windows, macOS, and Linux

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:renderer: node --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test src/renderer/boot-metrics.test.mjs src/renderer/sw-cache.test.mjs src/renderer/command-surface-stability.test.mjs src/renderer/composer-attachments.test.mjs src/renderer/composer-hooks.test.mjs src/renderer/editor-file-session.test.mjs src/renderer/editor-hooks.test.mjs src/renderer/explorer-logic.test.mjs src/renderer/focus-modality.test.mjs src/renderer/git-diff-refresh.test.mjs src/renderer/git-refresh-scheduler.test.mjs src/renderer/project-file-changes.test.mjs src/renderer/layout-persistence.test.mjs src/renderer/markdown-pipeline.test.mjs src/renderer/mobile-back.test.mjs src/renderer/mobile-surface.test.mjs src/renderer/mobile-tab-swipe.test.mjs src/renderer/motion-visibility.test.mjs src/renderer/pane-conversation-layout.test.mjs src/renderer/pane-drag-session.test.mjs src/renderer/remote-connection-state.test.mjs src/renderer/remote-payload-limit.test.mjs src/renderer/pane-workspace-state.test.mjs src/renderer/remote-claim-queue.test.mjs src/renderer/remote-pairing-recovery.test.mjs src/renderer/session-lane-store.test.mjs src/renderer/session-sidebar.test.mjs src/renderer/sidebar-reference-cache.test.mjs src/renderer/terminal-local-echo.test.mjs src/renderer/view-group-layout.test.mjs src/renderer/workbench-side-view-layout.test.mjs src/renderer/use-persisted-list-order.test.mjs src/renderer/transcript-interruption.test.mjs src/renderer/transcript-follow.test.mjs src/renderer/transcript-tool-activity.test.mjs
scripts.test:desktop-main: node --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test src/main/folder-explorer.test.mjs src/main/idle-reclaim.test.mjs src/main/project-files.test.mjs src/main/git-cli.test.mjs src/main/remote-deny-list.test.mjs
scripts.test:renderer:full: npm run test:desktop-main && npm run test:renderer
scripts.test:spec-advisory: node --max-old-space-size=1024 --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test src/renderer/product-spec.test.mjs src/renderer/agent-activity.test.mjs src/renderer/queue-actions.test.mjs src/renderer/turn-review.test.mjs
scripts.test:packaging: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="^(?!built runtime archive metadata and emitted native sidecar agree$)" src/main/packaging.test.mjs scripts/verify-update-metadata.test.mjs
scripts.verify:packaging-artifact: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="^built runtime archive metadata and emitted native sidecar agree$" src/main/packaging.test.mjs
scripts.test:session-transport: node scripts/build-daemon.mjs && node --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test src/main/desktop-service-client.test.mjs src/main/session-transport.test.mjs src/main/daemon.e2e.test.mjs src/main/remote-e2ee.test.mjs src/main/remote-transfer-optimization.test.mjs
scripts.verify:renderer: npm run test:renderer && node src/renderer/verify-renderer.mjs && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-daemon.mjs
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run brand:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:update-metadata
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 && npm run brand:win && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never && npm run verify:update-metadata
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --linux
